subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Is current-main source evidence plus the merged responsive-refresh PR enough to treat the Chrome 146 freeze as fixed, or should maintainers require live Chromium proof first?
rationale: The issue is credible and current main changed the suspected paths, but the exact pre-RPC Chrome UI-thread trigger has not been reproduced or disproven after those changes.

options.title: Require live Chromium proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main Chrome/Chromium run captures either a clean non-repro or the failing console/performance/WS evidence.

options.title: Accept current mitigations as sufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers are comfortable treating the responsive-refresh and topbar changes as enough without browser proof.

options.title: Design a safe UI fallback
options.body: Use this issue to drive an explicit fallback mode for affected Chromium builds, accepting a new user-visible behavior surface.

recommendation.title: Require live Chromium proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main Chrome/Chromium run captures either a clean non-repro or the failing console/performance/WS evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the strongest Dashboard v2 and responsive-refresh history for this browser UI surface.
